svg.aria-label: Results at a glance: semble puts 62% of the needed files in its top 10 (grep 33%); BM25 shows 22% of the needed lines within 8,000 tokens (semble 11%); on 50 hard tasks an agent alone found 46% of the needed files, 50% with semble and 44% with graphify, at 22% to 33% more cost per session
